title: Terminal-section lift of a topological resolution cocycle
statement: Let f:Z -> X be continuous, with additive direct image on abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Let KX and KZ be the sheafifications of the free abelian terminal representables and let a:KX -> f_*KZ send their generators to the inverse-image generators. For every sheaf F on Z, injective resolutions I of F and J of f_*F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], degree p, and cocycle s:KX -> J^p, there exist a chain map phi:J -> f_*I satisfying J.ι^0 followed by phi^0 equals f_*(I.ι^0), and a cocycle z:KZ -> I^p such that a followed by f_*z equals s followed by phi^p. This asserts only the existence of a resolution comparison and compatible cocycle, not any spectral-sequence or cohomology-map equality.

source.place: Tag 01F2 and the injective-resolution comparison argument; Tag 01DZ terminal-section representation

proof.text: Every term of f_*I is injective by injective preservation. Extend f_*(I.ι^0) across the mono J.ι^0 using injectivity. For the induction, exactness of the augmented resolution J makes the preceding chain-map composite factor through the image of the next source differential, which is a subobject of the next term of J. Extend from that subobject into the corresponding injective term of f_*I. These extensions define phi, its chain-map identities and its augmentation equation. No exactness of f_*I is needed.

The sheafification adjunction, free-forgetful adjunction and Yoneda give Hom(KZ,M)=M(Z) and Hom(KX,f_*M)=(f_*M)(X)=M(Z). The resulting bijection sends z to a followed by f_*z: check on the prescribed sheafification generators using their naturality, which determines the sheaf map. Apply its inverse to s followed by phi^p to obtain z. Naturality of this bijection for I.d, the chain-map equation and the cocycle equation for s imply that z followed by I.d is zero. This gives both required equations, including degree zero and the zero sheaf.

theorem exists_topological_resolution_cocycle_lift
    {Z X : TopCat.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [(TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).Additive]
    (a : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj
        ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)))
    (ha : (∀ (U : Opens X) (h : U ⟶ (⊤ : Opens X)),
        a.hom.app (op U)
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of h)) =
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op ((Opens.map f).obj U))
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of ((Opens.map f).map h ≫
                eqToHom (Opens.map_top f)))))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj F))
    (p : ℕ)
    (s : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            J.cocomplex.X p)
    (hs : s ≫ J.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0) :
    ∃ (φ : J.cocomplex ⟶
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex),
      J.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 = (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map (I.ι.f 0) ∧
      ∃ (z : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            I.cocomplex.X p),
        z ≫ I.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0 ∧
        a ≫ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map z = s ≫ φ.f p
